youtube_description:
Jesus's Replies — an imagined reply from Jesus, answered from Scripture.

Bible verse for heartbreak, when you're pretending you're over him.

She: Jesus... he posted a photo with her today. I liked it so he'd think I'm fine. 💔
She: Two years together. Three months apart. One tap, and I looked okay.
Jesus: You weren't liking a photo. You were hiding a wound.
She: Everyone says I should have moved on by now.
Jesus: Healing isn't pretending it doesn't hurt. It's letting Me near the part that does.
Jesus: You don't have to look fine tonight. Just be honest with Me.

“He heals the brokenhearted and binds up their wounds.”
Psalm 147:3 (BSB)
